title: Linked List Operations and Fast-Slow Pointers Quiz
description: A quick check to review linked list operations and the fast-slow pointer pattern.

questions.question: In the fast-slow pointer pattern, how does the fast pointer usually move?
questions.explanation: The fast pointer usually moves two steps at a time, while the slow pointer moves one step.

questions.question: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

head = Node(10)
head.next = Node(20)
head.next.next = Node(30)
head.next.next.next = Node(40)
head.next.next.next.next = Node(50)

slow = head
fast = head

while fast is not None and fast.next is not None:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next

print(slow.value)
questions.explanation: When fast reaches the end, slow points to the middle node, which has value 30.
